page.layout: One printed page (right half of the scan): one text column with marginal notes in the right margin. The left edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed. The running head is at the top, the page number at top right, a catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: quærebat animam tuam, & dedit Domi-nus domino meo regi ultionem hodiè de Saul & de semine eius : respondens autem Dauid, Rechab & Baanah fratri eius, dixit ad eos: {t}Viuit Dominus, qui eruitverf.9.10. animam meam de omni angustia, quoniam eum qui annuntiauerat mihi, & dixerat, mortuus est Saul, qui putabat prospera nunciare, tenui & occidi eum, quanto magis nunc, cùm homines impij interfecerunt virum innoxium, in domo sua, super lectum suum, non quæram sanguinem eius de manu vestra? & auferam vos de terra? {u}Præcepit itaq; David pueris suis, & in-verf.11.terfecerunt eos, præcidentesq; manus & pedes eorum, suspenderunt eos super pisci-nam in Hebron: caput autem Ishboseth tulerunt & sepelierunt in sepulchro Abner in Hebron. Bone Deus! quisquam mortalium, qui noverit solùm quid sit conscientia, quid Scriptura, putaret regicidas, & regicidarum patronos ista omnia legere, intelligere, credere, & tamen prorsus contraria moliri, imò tum privatim in absolutionibus, tum etiam publicè, tam in scriptis, quàm in scholis docere facienda? & facientes in al-bum

page.notes: Scripture passages (quærebat ... terra; Præcepit ... Hebron) are italic in the scan; the exact extent of italics in the short phrases "Dauid, Rechab & Baanah", "caput autem" and "Ishboseth" is approximate. "Ishboseth" may be printed "Ishboseth" or "Ishbosheth" as the s is hard to read at this scale; transcribed as printed. "præcidentesq;" read with some uncertainty. The reference marks {t} and {u} are small letters in the text, matched to the notes "verf.9.10." and "verf.11." in the right margin. The margin notes are transcribed as "verf.9.10." and "verf.11.", with the mark letter stored in the letter attribute. Catchword "bum" and signature "D" at the foot. The left edge of the scan shows the adjoining page and is not transcribed.
